context: An agreed plan that ends in the normal PR flow runs through the ffss delivery chain: slopguard for independent review, slopcourier to open the PR, and slopnanny through CI, review, and merge. Opening the PR is not the stopping point.

checklist.name: Independent review through slopguard
checklist.description: The independent review step is routed to slopguard, after the implementation and its checks pass. A stated fallback for when slopguard is unavailable in this environment is fine; a generic reviewer with no mention of slopguard is not

checklist.name: PR opened through slopcourier
checklist.description: Opening the pull request is routed to slopcourier. A stated fallback to `gh pr create` when slopcourier is unavailable in this environment is fine; a bare `gh pr create` with no mention of slopcourier is not

checklist.name: Babysat to merge through slopnanny
checklist.description: After the PR opens, CI and review are routed to slopnanny (a stated fallback when it is unavailable is fine), and the PR is squash-merged when green; the stopping point is the merged PR, not an open PR or a request for merge permission

checklist.name: Scope in dependency order
checklist.description: The flag and its integration coverage come before the output-contract docs

checklist.name: No invented results
checklist.description: Steps are presented as planned; no code, check, review, PR, or merge is claimed to have run
